# Support

## Where to ask

| Need | Channel |
|---|---|
| Usage, scope or design questions | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/HuangXin-erniu/scs-fishery-kb/discussions) |
| Bug in documentation, configuration or tooling | [Bug report](https://github.com/HuangXin-erniu/scs-fishery-kb/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| New corpus source proposal | [Data source proposal](https://github.com/HuangXin-erniu/scs-fishery-kb/issues/new?template=data_source.yml) |
| Security vulnerability | [Private vulnerability report](https://github.com/HuangXin-erniu/scs-fishery-kb/security/advisories/new) |
| 中文说明 | [README.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/HuangXin-erniu/scs-fishery-kb/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) |

## What not to post

- Data payloads, indexes, run artifacts or state databases.
- Restricted, unlicensed or personal material; full AIS/VMS tracks.
- Credentials, tokens or private keys.

## Response

Maintainers respond on a best-effort basis. There is no service-level agreement.
For security reports, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## 中文说明

提问、缺陷与数据源建议请使用上面的入口；不要贴数据、密钥或受限材料。安全漏洞请走私密报告。
